network.description: Internal service and development network settings.

explorer.description: Explorer address used to allow its hostname in the development server.

lsp.description: Reserved LSP address. Proxy routing is configured separately with LUZZLE_PROXY_LSP_UPSTREAM.

worker.description: Worker service address for health checks.

host.description: Development server bind address, not the public site URL.

hmr_port.description: Vite hot-reload client port, when different from the server port.

app.description: Public Explorer URL. Supports an explicit environment reference.

app_assets.description: Application asset base URL. Empty uses same-origin paths; a CDN URL is allowed.

luzzle_assets.description: Published piece asset base URL. Empty uses same-origin paths; a CDN URL is allowed.

auth.description: Configure exactly one authentication provider and a session secret. Omit auth for a public-only site with admin access disabled.

secret.description: Session-signing secret. Supply a strong random value or an explicit environment reference; required whenever auth is configured.

password.description: Administrator password or an explicit environment reference.

name.description: Label shown on the sign-in button.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL or an explicit environment reference.

clientSecret.description: OIDC client secret or an explicit environment reference.

config.description: rclone configuration file used by the worker.

archive.description: Bidirectional archive synchronization using rclone bisync.

remote.description: rclone remote name, not an s3:// URL. Empty remote or path skips archive synchronization.

path.description: Remote archive path, combined with the remote name as remote:path.

flags.description: Additional rclone arguments, one argument per array entry.

cdn.description: Publish generated assets to a remote destination.

remote.description: rclone remote name. Empty remote or path skips CDN synchronization.

path.description: Remote published-assets path, combined as remote:path.

strategy.description: sync deletes destination-only files; copy does not.

path.description: Workflow queue database path. The legacy sidequest.sqlite filename is mapped to openworkflow.sqlite by the application.

ai.description: AI generation settings. Omit ai to disable generation; both provider and api_key must be supplied when configured.

provider.description: Generation provider. Google is currently the supported provider; this field is required.

api_key.description: Provider API key or an explicit environment reference.

database.description: SQLite index path, resolved relative to the config directory.

prepared.description: Prepared template bundle revisions, resolved relative to the config directory. Server-only artifact data shared by worker and web, not a public asset folder.

assets.description: Generated piece assets directory. Worker generation uses its working directory for relative paths.

salt.description: Salt for generated asset keys. Changing it changes published asset URLs.

404.description: Svelte source path for the not-found page.

root.description: Svelte source path for the home page.

feed.description: Svelte source path for the feed.

about.description: Markdown file for the feed explanation card. Omit to hide the card.
